revision: 1. Visual Metaphor: Replace the abstract geometric mountain and zig-zag line with a high-contrast, textured silhouette of a pine forest ridge. Transform the fire element into a stylized, organic ember trail or flame front that actively consumes the ridge, using multi-layered gradients (deep red to bright yellow) and turbulence filters to simulate heat distortion and organic chaos. 2. Composition & Hierarchy: Shift from static centering to dynamic asymmetry. Anchor the headline 'ONE SPARK IS ENOUGH' in the top-left corner to initiate a diagonal visual path that follows the rising fire line toward the right. Place the body text ('Check conditions...') in the lower-left negative space to balance the visual weight of the fire, ensuring the layout reads as a deliberate whole from a distance. 3. Typography: Remove the artificial white outer glow from the headline. Instead, ground the text using a subtle drop shadow or dark gradient mask to integrate it with the atmospheric smoke. Use a condensed grotesque typeface to match the verticality of the landscape, ensuring the headline acts as a structural element rather than a floating sticker. 4. Atmosphere & Craft: Apply a subtle noise texture to the dark background gradient to eliminate digital sterility and add grit. Ensure the color palette maintains high contrast between the glowing fire and the dark landscape to preserve legibility and emotional urgency without resorting to sensationalism.
protected_strengths: High-contrast color hierarchy (bright fire against dark mountain) for distance legibility
Clear typographic hierarchy separating headline from instructional body text
Effective use of glowing aesthetic to signify danger and heat
resolved_conflicts: Conflict: Static centered layout vs. Dynamic diagonal fire energy -> Resolution: Adopt asymmetrical balance by anchoring text top-left and balancing with fire on the right, creating a directional visual path.

Conflict: Abstract/sterile geometry vs. Emotional urgency -> Resolution: Replace low-poly shapes with textured, organic silhouettes and roughened flame effects to evoke the specific reality of wildfire risk.

Conflict: Artificial neon glow vs. Atmospheric integration -> Resolution: Replace uniform white halos with grounded shadows and texture to embed typography within the smoky environment rather than floating above it.
rationale: This brief prioritizes the integration of all four mandates by treating the visual metaphor (organic fire/forest) as the foundation for the composition (asymmetrical flow). It resolves the tension between 'readability' and 'atmosphere' by grounding typography in the scene's lighting rather than isolating it with generic effects, ensuring the poster feels both urgent and professionally crafted.
